question: How do the disagreement count's balls grow and what do their outlines look like on the endless six-regular weave under not-all-equal and on chain grids (exact infinite-plane correlations), and does ball growth read how many orders a grown split base has, without names?

definitions.C: 1 - 2d/N for two distinctions, d their disagreement count
definitions.A: sqrt(r) C, r the literature's Euclidean separation
definitions.ball: distinctions with C >= u (raw count below N/2) or tau <= tau0
definitions.outline: ball members with one of their count-nearest distinctions (six on the weave, four on the chain grid) outside the ball
definitions.k: least colours of the splits' crossing graph
definitions.reading c: multiset of sorted state Hamming rows

forbidden_inputs: Changing cases, readings, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
